command:# Reports live under temporary-docs/gnomish/<task>/: the task branch's name without its
# gnomish/ prefix (the factory's own sanitized taskId), 'local' off a task branch.
branch=$(git branch --show-current)
case "$branch" in gnomish/*) task=${branch#gnomish/} ;; *) task=local ;; esac
dir=temporary-docs/gnomish/$task
change=$(sed -n 's/^Change:[[:space:]]*//p' $dir/change.md | head -1)
tasks="openspec/changes/$change/tasks.md"
open=$(grep -nE '^[[:space:]]*- \[ \]' "$tasks" || true)
if [ -n "$open" ]; then
  echo "$tasks still has unticked tasks:"
  echo "$open"
  echo "implement each of them, one subagent per task, and tick it once you have verified its work - not when the subagent says so. If a task cannot be done as written, do not tick it: escalate through \$GNOMISH_DECISION_FILE."
  exit 1
fi
if [ ! -f $dir/implement.md ]; then
  echo "no implementation record at $dir/implement.md - write it before finishing the round, see .gnomish/stages/implement/instructions.md"
  exit 1
fi
